note: Estimate, not a measurement of the Bortle scale. Naked-eye limiting magnitudes are from John E. Bortle, Sky & Telescope, February 2001. Classes 6–9 are single figures in that article; the steps between them are filled in here. The catalog stops at magnitude 7, so a sky darker than the class for limiting magnitude 7.0 (score 3) cannot be distinguished from that class. Replace these bounds once we have our own dark-site and downtown photos.
